description: Jellyfin Enhanced coexistence on the legacy desktop: viewer with accessroles-je-probe.mjs's lock-only role (Profile, Quick Connect, Jellyfin Enhanced locked) next to Jellyfin Enhanced 12.14. JE's entries to its settings panel (the drawer's link, the Settings page's) are in the page and hidden; JE's D key (GoToDashboard: '#/dashboard') ends on Home, the core bouncing a non-admin; JE's Q key (QuickConnect: '#/quickconnect') ends on Home with the guard's toast; a recorder of every address the page took, installed before any page script, shows each key reached its page first, and a frame recorder that neither locked page was ever visible.

steps.name: a recorder of the page's addresses and of visible Quick Connect or Dashboard frames, before any page script
steps.initScript: (() => { const R = window.__jfarJe = { hashes: [], frames: {}, toasts: [] }; const note = () => { const h = location.hash; if (R.hashes[R.hashes.length - 1] !== h) R.hashes.push(h); }; window.addEventListener('hashchange', note, true); window.addEventListener('popstate', note, true); const tick = () => { try { note(); document.querySelectorAll('.jfar-toast').forEach((t) => { const x = t.textContent; if (x && !R.toasts.includes(x)) R.toasts.push(x); }); document.querySelectorAll('#quickConnectPreferencesPage, .page.type-interior.dashboardHomePage, #dashboardPage').forEach((p) => { if (!p.classList.contains('hide') && p.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(p).visibility !== 'hidden') { R.frames[p.id || p.className] = (R.frames[p.id || p.className] || 0) + 1; } }); } catch (e) { } requestAnimationFrame(tick); }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); })()

steps.name: the guard has viewer's /Me with the three locks
JE loaded with its key listener and its shortcuts (activeShortcuts filled after its config loads)
JE's keys are D and Q
JE's drawer link is in the page (JE adds it a moment after the drawer is built)
JE's drawer link
steps.eval: (() => { const e = document.getElementById('jellyfinEnhancedSettingsLink'); return { inPage: !!e, display: e ? getComputedStyle(e).display : null, rects: e ? e.getClientRects().length : null }; })()

steps.name: JE's drawer link hidden (display none, no box)
JE has had its time to add its Settings entry
JE's entries on the Settings page
steps.eval: (() => { const ids = ['jellyfinEnhancedUserPrefsLink', 'enhancedSettingsBtn', 'jellyfinEnhancedSettingsLink', 'jellyfinEnhancedUserMenuLink']; return ids.map((id) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); return { id, inPage: !!e, display: e ? getComputedStyle(e).display : null, rects: e ? e.getClientRects().length : null }; }); })()

steps.name: every JE entry in the page is hidden
nothing focused, the recorder reset
steps.script: if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement !== document.body) document.activeElement.blur(); window.__jfarJe.hashes = [location.hash]; window.__jfarJe.frames = {}; window.__jfarJe.toasts = []; return location.hash;

steps.name: where D went
steps.eval: ({ hashes: window.__jfarJe.hashes.slice(), now: location.hash, frames: Object.assign({}, window.__jfarJe.frames), toasts: window.__jfarJe.toasts.slice() })

steps.name: D took the page to the Dashboard's address, and it ended on Home without the Dashboard ever shown
nothing focused, the recorder reset again
steps.script: if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement !== document.body) document.activeElement.blur(); window.__jfarJe.hashes = [location.hash]; window.__jfarJe.frames = {}; window.__jfarJe.toasts = []; document.querySelectorAll('.jfar-toast').forEach((t) => t.remove()); return location.hash;

steps.name: where Q went
steps.eval: ({ hashes: window.__jfarJe.hashes.slice(), now: location.hash, frames: Object.assign({}, window.__jfarJe.frames), toasts: window.__jfarJe.toasts.slice() })

steps.name: Q took the page to Quick Connect's address, and it ended on Home with the guard's toast, Quick Connect never shown
steps.assert: __vars.q.hashes.some((h) => /^#\/quickconnect/i.test(h)) && __vars.q.now.startsWith('#/home') && Object.keys(__vars.q.frames).length === 0 && __vars.q.toasts.includes('This page is managed by your server administrator.')

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag and jellyfin-web's Home tab slider excepted)
